name: Zebra
scene: A zebra head with bold stripes.
notes: Medium design; target 28–45 panes. Regenerated once to simplify excessive stripes. Final raster inspection counts 39 enclosed pane interiors excluding exterior, using connected components above 500 pixels. Indigo/gold subject and teal/azure background pairs are preserved. Closed eye, broad neck stripes and closed oval rim; no obvious loose line ends. Remaining doubts: subtle fill shading persists, and tight junctions at ear bases and where mane joins neck need review during tracing; a few same-colour subject neighbours may merge. Design sheet only; not geometry-audited or published.
